_meta.rule: provision_clickup_fields.py --apply runs only under an entry here whose status is approved. The entry is set to spent by the run itself, whatever the outcome. A draft or spent entry admits nothing, and entries are never deleted, so every field created stays explained.
_meta.enforcement: Preventive for the script (it refuses to apply without an approved entry) and detective for everything else: a field created by hand in the ClickUp UI leaves no trace here, which is why the audit record names what the script itself created.
_meta.human_gate: Risk Class 3 (Constitution section 5). Owner sign-off is required per entry and is quoted in it.
_meta.secrets: None here, ever. The token is read from the CLICKUP_TOKEN environment variable at run time.

authorisations.approved: 2026-09-23, owner instruction in writing: create the four Sector bridge fields by direct REST call rather than by hand, as a permanent change to real CRM structure.
authorisations.permits: Creating ONLY the four named fields on the allowlisted target, only if absent. Nothing else.
authorisations.forbids: Any rename, delete, reorder or value write; any other list, folder or space; any task, contact, member, comment or activity read; any retry after a failed create.
authorisations.blocked_until: CLICKUP_TOKEN is present in the environment. Until then --apply refuses and nothing is created.
